reference.author: Mike Kasberg
reference.units: mm assumed; corroborated by source sheet dimensions, STL contains no units

mapping.sheet: Source measured 1.60-mm sheet becomes inserts, feet, frame and plaque backing; supported1.6–2.4 mm. Plaque receives a proposed0.8mm pocket depth on top of that backing.
mapping.socket: Source 4.50×1.70mm socket becomes original two-foot mortises: width4.50+total clearance; narrow dimension actual sheet+total clearance. Tongues4.50mm wide, sheet-deep, sheet-thick. Default4.65×1.75mm; not claimed identical source fit.
mapping.runner: Source low bed-contact runners reconstructed with 28 accessible bridges, proposed0.4–0.6mm thick and0.8–1.2mm wide. Each part has four connections; plaque connections deliberately outside tongue zone.
mapping.novelty: Seven-part tangible Descartes/Soddy-circle packing display, not a reel, pendulum, switch, static file re-export or cosmetic mechanism reskin. Three equal circle centers2r apart, central ideal radius r/(3+2sqrt3); all four insert radii reduced by gap/2 to leave six controlled non-touching gaps. Four shallow pockets and two calibrated feet assemble into an upright display.
mapping.interfacePreservation: Measured sheet and4.50-mm socket/tongue width are actual parameters/constraints. Proposed clearance0.10–0.30mm total, adhesive retention and pocket geometry are new design decisions, not measured source claims.
mapping.personalization: Exact supported STL Boolean engraving and sampled image heights affect upper plaque lug only; safe radius6.5mm, depth0.4–0.6mm. Leaves>=1mm backing and avoids pockets/feet.
mapping.minimumFeatures: Nominal circle radius14–18mm and separation1.0–1.4mm intentionally bound the small insert radius>=1.46mm and top pocket lands>=0.7mm even at maximum0.30mm fit clearance. Larger physical gaps distinguish printable near-tangency from exact mathematical contact.
